Culture Benefits Awards Department Overviews Students and Recent Grads Frequently Asked Questions Current Openings Medical Necessity Criteria and Clinical Review Guidelines Care Management uses nationally recognized and accepted utilization management criteria, as well as internally developed policies, guidelines and protocols for medical necessity determination. All criteria are annually reviewed and updated as necessary. Simply access the criteria that match the service type that you will be providing by choosing the appropriate link, located below. Please contact the Care Management telephone number on the back of the member's identification card should you have any questions. Criteria Type Medical Mutual uses the following Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Service (CMS) clinical criteria to ensure appropriateness of care and service: CMS Medical Benefit Policy Manual CMS Medicare Coverage Database (MCD) CGS Administrators, LLC., Jurisdiction A/B Medical Policies Medical Policies provide guidelines for determining coverage for specific procedures, therapies, devices, equipment and services. InterQual Guidelines InterQual provides guidelines for determining coverage for inpatient care as well as specific procedures, devices, equipment and services. MCG Guidelines MCG provides guidelines for determining coverage for inpatient care as well as specific procedures, devices, equipment and services. Cohere Go here for Therapy/Chiro, Radiology/Imaging, Gastroenterology, Cardiology and Sleep-related Services codes that require prior authorization. Go here for information on Review Criteria. EviCore Go here for Radiation Oncology codes that require prior authorization. Go here for information on Review Criteria.
